## Generator unit ground truth
Generators speak **METERS** (world units), centered at origin. Evidence:
- `framework/gpu/3d.zig:2756` — `STAGE_TILE_M: f32 = 1.0` ("one panel = one game tile = 1 m"), `STAGE_FINE_DIV = 16` (1 u = 1/16 m pitch); comment at :2752 pins "1 game tile = 1 m = 16 u".
- `cart/editor/model/editMesh.ts:653-676` — the shape constructors "mint an EditMesh CENTERED at the origin, sized to its dims"; verts feed the host mesh directly with no scaling, so a `cuboid(1,1,1)` spans exactly one tile panel (matches the wave-1 shots). Therefore dialog u → generator = `/16`.

## Changes
**`cart/editor/data/hmscAssetCatalog.ts`** (~:260-360):
- `U_PER_TILE = 16` exported; `PrimitiveField` gains `unit: 'u' | 'count'` + `diameter?` flag.
- Size/Diameter/Height fields: min 1, max 800, step 1, default 16 u (old: 0.1..50 dimensionless). Segments/Subdivisions unchanged, marked `unit: 'count'`.
- `defaultPrimitiveParamsU(kind)` — dialog-space (u) defaults; `primitiveParamsFromU(p)` — the ONE boundary conversion: `{size: u/16, height: u/16, resolution: untouched}`.
- `restOnGround(mesh)` — lifts the authored mesh so min-Y = 0; applied inside `primitiveEditMesh`, so **both** paths (fresh doc via `primitiveMeshData`, add-part via `primitivePartMesh`) rest on the floor, composing with any size (32-u cube: base 0, top 2 m). Plane (already at y=0) is a no-op.
- `PrimitiveParams` public semantics stay meters — AppFrame (not mine) is untouched and its `RJIT_MODELDOC` boot (`{size:1,height:1,resolution:1}`) still means a one-tile cube.

**`cart/editor/shell/NewMeshDialog.tsx`** (rewritten):
- Basis header: `Units: 16 u = 1 tile (1 m). Same basis as per-face UV.` (replaces the flavor sentence).
- Per field: a stepper row on the shared control grid — label column `REGIONS.grid.labelWidth`, columns `[−16][−1][N u value][+1][+16]` (coarse ±16 = one tile; count rows reserve blank coarse cells so every value cell and the right edge align, req_2626/2627), fine buttons `grid.stepBtn`, value cell `grid.valueWidth` monospace centered; a coarse Slider scrubber (step 1) under each row.
- Live readout row: `= X.XX tile × Y.YY tile` (⌀ prefix for diameter kinds), recomputed from state.
- Add converts once: `onAdd(primitiveParamsFromU(p))`.

## Spawn verification (headless, self-capture)
- `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube ./tools/rjit shot editor --out .../spawn_rest.png --frames 40` → PASS, `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/40eebdf5-ae0f-4114-b3f9-c2c8545b2b9f/scratchpad/spawn_rest.png` — default 3/4 view, cube spanning the center tile with the ground axes emerging at its base.
- Decisive shot: same + `RJIT_MESHOPS="orbit:0,-120;wait:5"` → `.../spawn_side3.png` — camera just below the ground plane: the red/blue y=0 axes cross exactly at the cube's bottom-face center, base coplanar with the tile grid, cube extends only upward (green axis rises from the base into the body). Not half-sunk.
- Dialog layout: no headless click driver exists for File → New Mesh, so verified by code reading; the shot's bundle rebuild (`bundle-editor.js` OK) proves the new dialog parses/bundles.

- None blocking. One pre-existing uncommitted hunk from a parallel session (`modelPackageMeshData`, req_2598) lived in hmscAssetCatalog.ts and rode along in the commit per the commit-don't-hedge-shared-files convention.
- Renamed `defaultPrimitiveParams` → `defaultPrimitiveParamsU` (u-space); grepped repo-wide — the only consumers were my two files. Not pushed, request board untouched, as instructed.</result>
